headings.text: Murali Resort & Convention Center — Where Moments Become Memories.
A Destination Designed for Scale & Elegance.
Celebrated your milestone event at Murali Resort?
Plan Your Event at Murali Resort.

paragraphs.text: A scenic resort for weddings, parties, and business events on open green lawns.
Located on Poranki Road in Vijayawada, Murali Resort pairs modern halls with green lawns. Host grand weddings and events with ease. Your guests will enjoy plenty of space to celebrate in comfort.
Find the right space for your wedding, business conference, or relaxing stay.
A spacious indoor hall with clear views, crystal lighting, and quality sound. Perfect for banquets and large meetings.
Browse real photos from weddings, receptions, and banquets at Murali Resort. Drag or scroll to explore the gallery.
A grand wedding walkway with crystal lights, fresh flowers, and a red carpet.
Murali Resort sits on Poranki Road in Vijayawada, with easy highway access. A wide driveway lets your guests arrive and park with ease.
Survey No - 134, Poranki-Nidamanuru Road,Poranki, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh 521137
Direct access from Poranki Road links you quickly to the city center and main highways.
A covered porch and circular driveway let guests drive right up to the main hall with no traffic delays.
Separate service gates keep catering and decor teams away from guests, so events run quietly and smoothly.
Real reviews from guests who hosted weddings, parties, and meetings at Murali Resort.
Verified Google Rating · 1,300+ reviews
“Very spacious place for conducting marriage and other big functions. Big car parking and sufficient for good number of gathering.”
“Very good and big convention halls and huge parking area”

“Wow Murali resort is the best option for function Hall. And also it's best option for meetings. I enjoyed meetings here I attended two times here in murali resorts. I thoroughly enjoyed with my family especially my kids spent good time here. Waiting to visit again when I get the opertunity...”

“One of the best convention halls for functions. It easily holds up to 1,500 people, and the service is great. The resort is located in a peaceful area away from the busy city. Everything was well designed.”
Join our community of hosts by sharing your honest experience on Google Maps.
Talk to our team to check open dates, discuss hall setups, and plan catering or guest rooms.
A premier venue for weddings, family parties, and corporate events in Vijayawada. We offer an indoor hall for 800 seated guests, open lawns, and on-site guest rooms.
© 2026 Murali Resort. All rights reserved.

paragraphs.text: Spaces that work as hard as they look, equipped with everything you need.

Our modern conference halls are built for clear focus and great events. Enjoy open views with no pillars, quiet soundproof walls, and window blinds for screens. You can divide the hall into four rooms or open it up for large talks.

Give your guests fresh air and natural views in total comfort. Our green terraces wrap around the main building with warm evening lights and sunset skies. They are great for welcome drinks, photo sessions, or open-air dinner under the stars.

Our resort kitchen is led by skilled chefs who create fresh menus for every event. From light finger foods to full plated dinners, we tailor every dish to your taste. Your guests will enjoy great food and attentive service throughout the meal.

Plans can change quickly during an event. Our on-site team is available 24 hours a day to help with every detail. We handle guest arrivals, travel rides, room bookings, and last-minute requests with ease.

Fast internet and modern tech power every event at our resort. We offer high-speed fiber Wi-Fi, HD video cameras for live streaming, and clear sound systems. Our on-site tech team helps make sure everything runs smoothly.

Our venue is ready for your personal touch. Our design team works with top florists, lighting specialists, and decor partners to bring your vision to life. We style each room to match your event theme and colors.
